subject: Sparrow-Lite 3B: compatibility validation and temporary pin request
messages:
From: Lucas Chen <lucas@acme-analytics.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-11T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: onboard Sparrow-Lite 3B variant for Acme's summarization workload

Hi Tessa / Laura,

Hope you're both well — we've been working with the Acme team on reducing latency for their realtime summarization flows. They evaluated Sparrow-Lite 3B (sparrow-lite-3b-v2) from OpenHub.ai and saw token-level cost savings, but they hit some inference differences compared to the current Sparrow-3B.x baseline (shorter completions for long-context prompts).

Can Redwood onboard the Sparrow-Lite 3B variant as a serving candidate for their dedicated pool so Acme can run end-to-end validation? We're aiming for a canary in their dedicated environment next week. I attached a compatibility matrix and the vendor eval PDF for context.

Attachments: sparrow-lite-compat-matrix.csv, sparrow-lite-eval-report.pdf

Thanks,
Lucas
Account Lead, Acme Analytics

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Lucas Chen <lucas@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-09-11T13:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: onboard Sparrow-Lite 3B variant for Acme's summarization workload

Thanks Lucas — looping in infra and runtime leads to assess compatibility and to triage the observed output differences.

Ask summary:
- Run Redwood compatibility checks for sparrow-lite-3b-v2 against our serving runtime (tokenization, KV cache, quantization artifact risk).
- Run a short end-to-end canary in Acme's dedicated pool (isolated) and capture perf/latency token counts.
- If there are safety or regressions in generation quality, we want a temporary pin to the current baseline (Sparrow-3B.x) for Acme's tenant while we investigate.

Proposed timeline: compatibility checks by EOD Friday (2026-09-12), canary ready early next week. Markus / Dev — can you confirm feasibility and whether a temporary pin policy is required from your side?

Tessa Morgan
Director, Customer Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Lucas Chen <lucas@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-09-11T15:48:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: onboard Sparrow-Lite 3B variant for Acme's summarization workload

On Fri, 11 Sep 2026 at 13:05, Tessa Morgan wrote:
> Thanks Lucas — looping in infra and runtime leads to assess compatibility and to triage the observed output differences.

Quick status and checklist from runtime:
- Tokenization: sparrow-lite-3b-v2 uses the same byte-level BPE as our baseline; tokenizer mismatch looks unlikely. Will run token-diff scripts against Acme prompt set.
- KV cache / attention: variant introduces a fused attention kernel which changes numeric rounding behavior at long contexts. This can lead to subtle completion length differences; we need deterministic regression tests.
- Quantization: vendor shipped an int8 calibration table; we need to validate accuracy vs our quantized runtime (we have an internal quant_eval harness).

I can run the compatibility tests and a short generation regression suite by 2026-09-12 20:00Z. If we see anything failing, we should issue a per-tenant pin on the Acme dedicated model route until we resolve. Proposed pin mechanism: route override in the tenant routing table with rollout_state = "pinned" and fallback to Sparrow-3B.x. Markus, I'll need the config key path for the tenant override and a short maintenance window to toggle.

Dev Patel
Lead, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Lucas Chen <lucas@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T09:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: onboard Sparrow-Lite 3B variant for Acme's summarization workload

Thanks — product notes:
- We need a short canary plan (3 days, 5% traffic, rollback criteria) documented in the onboarding ticket. Please add the exact metric thresholds we should watch (ROUGE-L/length bias, P95 latency, token cost delta).
- If runtime shows deterministic completion shortening, we should surface that to Acme as a known behavior and offer a quick prompt-template mitigation (prefix instruction).
- Can we also include a small eval harness that Acme can run on their side (we'll share a reduced prompt set)? That will speed acceptance.

Laura Bennett
Product Manager, Model Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Lucas Chen <lucas@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T16:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: onboard Sparrow-Lite 3B variant for Acme's summarization workload

Acknowledged.

I can do the tenant-level routing override — quick implementation details:
- Config path: /tenants/acme-analytics/routes/summary-model/override
- To pin: set rollout: { "state": "pinned", "model": "sparrow-3b.x" }
- To unpin: set rollout: { "state": "auto", "policy": "canary" }

I'll stage the override in the sandbox today and coordinate a 30-minute change window for toggling in Acme's dedicated pool. Dev: please provide the test run outputs so I can validate plan. Also attaching the safety checklist we use for variant rollouts.

Attachments: safety-checklist.md

Markus Klein
Engineering Manager, Dedicated Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Lucas Chen <lucas@acme-analytics.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-13T17:34:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: onboard Sparrow-Lite 3B variant for Acme's summarization workload

Summary / next steps (agreed):
1) Dev to run compatibility + regression suite and share results (token-diff, quant eval, canary perf) by 2026-09-12 20:00Z — if failures, trigger pinned override.
2) Markus to stage tenant override and confirm toggle command; 30-minute maintenance window scheduled for 2026-09-14 03:00Z UTC.
3) Laura to prepare canary doc with metric thresholds (ROUGE-L delta > 3, P95 latency increase > 40ms, token-cost delta > 8% as initial draft).
4) Lucas/Acme to run the reduced eval harness and confirm acceptance criteria by end of canary.

Thanks everyone — we'll treat the pinned override as temporary until the full regression and quantization validation are complete.

Tessa Morgan
Director, Customer Engineering
Redwood Inference
